description: Frontend: proof-upload section in resident census_update.php (JS-driven, shown when name/DOB fields change) and diff-view modal in secretary/residents.php with Review Changes button per submitted update. Depends on FEAT-001 routes existing.
steps: 1. In app/Views/dashboard/resident/census_update.php: Update the <form> tag to add enctype='multipart/form-data'.

2. In census_update.php: Add a hidden proof-upload section div with id='proofUploadSection' styled as a .cu-section. Place it just before the .census-actions div (the submit buttons row) in BOTH the household-head branch ($canEditHousehold=true) and the member-only branch ($canEditHousehold=false). Content of the div: .cu-section-bar with text 'Proof of Identity Change Required' and icon fas fa-id-card. .cu-section-body with: (a) A paragraph: 'You changed personal identity information. Please upload a valid ID or supporting document (PSA birth certificate, government-issued ID, etc.) as proof. Accepted: JPG, PNG, PDF.' (b) A .form-group with file input name='proof_document' accept='.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.pdf'. Style to match existing .cu-section/.cu-section-bar/.cu-section-body pattern. Initially hidden: style='display:none;'.

3. In census_update.php: Add a <script> block before </body>. The script must: (a) Collect original DB values into a JS object using PHP-echoed values: for head branch — originalValues = { last_name: '<?= esc($household["last_name"] ?? "", "js") ?>', first_name: '...', middle_name: '...', suffix: '...', date_of_birth: '...' }; for member branch — originalValues = { last_name: '<?= esc($ownLast, "js") ?>', first_name: '...', middle_name: '...', date_of_birth: '...' }. (b) Define watchIds: for head — ['last_name','first_name','middle_name','suffix','date_of_birth']; for member — ['member_last_name','member_first_name','member_middle_name','member_date_of_birth']. (c) Map watchIds to their originalValues keys. (d) On each input's 'input'/'change' event, check if current value !== original value; if any watched field differs, show #proofUploadSection; otherwise hide it. (e) Run the check once on DOMContentLoaded. Use document.getElementById() for each watched field.

4. In app/Views/dashboard/secretary/residents.php: In the $residents table rows, after the existing gear/envelope buttons, add a 'Review Changes' button that is only rendered when the resident has a submitted census update. To know this, UIController::secretary_residents() must pass a lookup map of user_id => auth_id for submitted updates. Add to UIController::secretary_residents() (around line 1170, in the view data array): 'submittedCensusUpdates' => (new \App\Models\CensusUpdateAuthorizationModel())->listForReview(['submitted','sent']) then build the lookup map in the view. In the view at the top of the table loop, add: $submittedUpdatesByUser = []; foreach ($submittedCensusUpdates ?? [] as $cu) { $uid = (int)($cu['user_id'] ?? 0); if ($uid > 0) $submittedUpdatesByUser[$uid] = (int)$cu['id']; } Then inside the per-resident actions cell (where the gear button is), check if ($r['user_id'] && isset($submittedUpdatesByUser[(int)$r['user_id']])): render a button: .

5. In residents.php: Add a new diff modal with id='censusUpdateDiffModal' following the .pa-overlay/.pa-modal pattern already in use for approveModal/rejectModal. Modal structure: .pa-modal-header (title 'Review Census Update', subtitle 'Compare current record to proposed changes'). .pa-modal-body: (a) A #cuDiffResidentName <strong> heading with resident name and submitted_at. (b) A #cuDiffProofWrap section (hidden by default) showing the proof document — if the proof_url ends in .pdf show a link; if image show a small thumbnail. (c) A #cuDiffTable: a <table> with columns 'Field', 'Current Value', 'Proposed Change'. Rows are generated by JS from the diff array. If diff is empty and confirm_only is true, show a single row 'Resident confirmed information is correct, no changes.'. (d) A textarea for rejection reason with id='cuDiffRejectReason'. (e) .pa-modal-footer with Cancel, Approve, and Reject buttons.

6. In residents.php <script> block: Add openCensusUpdateDiff(userId, authId) function that: (a) Shows the modal in a loading state. (b) Fetches GET /secretary/resident/census-update-diff/{authId} using fetch(). (c) On success, populates the diff table, proof section, resident name. (d) Wires Approve button to POST /secretary/resident/approve-census-update/{authId} with CSRF token via a hidden form submit. (e) Wires Reject button to POST /secretary/resident/reject-census-update/{authId} with remarks from the textarea. Use the existing openApprove/openReject pattern: build FormData, include CSRF token from document.querySelector('input[name^="csrf_"]'). After successful approve/reject, close the modal and reload the page. Handle fetch errors with an alert.

7. Detect the current role prefix for fetch URLs: the residents page is shared by /secretary/residents and /admin/residents (UIController::secretary_residents is used by both). In the view, determine the role prefix by inspecting the current URL or passing it from the controller. The safest approach: In UIController::secretary_residents(), add 'rolePrefix' => session()->get('role') to the view data. In the view JS, use PHP to echo the role prefix: const ROLE_PREFIX = '<?= esc(session()->get("role"), "js") ?>';. Then use ROLE_PREFIX in all fetch URLs inside the modal JS.
acceptance_criteria: When a resident edits last_name, first_name, middle_name, suffix, or date_of_birth in the head form, the proof upload section appears without page reload.
When a resident edits member_last_name, member_first_name, member_middle_name, or member_date_of_birth in the member form, the proof upload section appears without page reload.
The proof section disappears when all watched fields are reverted to their original values.
On secretary/residents page, a 'Review Changes' button appears next to residents who have submitted a census update.
Clicking 'Review Changes' opens a modal showing a diff table (old vs new values) and a proof document thumbnail/link if present.
Clicking Approve in the modal POSTs to the approve endpoint and reloads the page.
Clicking Reject in the modal POSTs to the reject endpoint with the reason and reloads the page.
php -l passes on all modified PHP files.
